title: Zachraňme náš stát peace march to Vítkov
scope: Distinct May 1 march described in same CTK story as separate anarchist procession and KSČM meeting.
threshold_50_evidence: ČTK reports about 200 in the march to Vítkov; threshold established.

actual_occurrence.summary: ČTK reports a May 1 march from Republic Square to Vítkov (S002 lines 18–42).

location.summary: Republic Square to Vítkov, Prague (S002 lines 18–42).

demands.summary: Speakers criticized current Czech government and domestic policy on Ukraine/EU/Green Deal (S002 lines 18–42).

notes: Speakers called for unity against current government and criticized EU/Green Deal and Czech policy on Ukraine. One CTK story is not independent corroboration.
open_questions: No exact attendance bounds or state response described.

organizer: Anarchist organizers; exact organization not specified

actual_occurrence.summary: ČTK reports procession from Střelecký Ostrov to Štvanice on May 1 (S002 lines 18–42).

title: Vrabel anti-government rally and march
location: Wenceslas Square to Malostranské Square, Prague
scope: Public rally and march; separate pro-Ukraine counterprotest nearby not included in attendance.
threshold_50_evidence: iROZHLAS reports several hundred; separate counterprotest was only dozens and not additive.

actual_occurrence.summary: iROZHLAS reports the May 6 rally and march (S003 lines 28–65).

demands.summary: Opposed government/war; cheaper energy and Czech exit from NATO/EU (S003).

state_response.summary: One participant detained on suspected genocide-denial offense; nearby counterprotest is separate (S003).

notes: Against government and war; sought cheaper energy and Czech exit from NATO/EU. One participant detained on suspicion of genocide denial; separate counterprotest had dozens. iROZHLAS footer credits ČTK.
open_questions: No precise attendance or end time; source dependence noted.

title: KSČM protest against Czech-US Defense Cooperation Agreement
scope: Single protest meeting against proposed Czech-US agreement.
threshold_50_evidence: iROZHLAS reports around 100 at the public protest; count attributed through article, threshold established.

actual_occurrence.summary: iROZHLAS reports the protest at Malostranské Square on May 30 (S004 lines 28–50).

demands.summary: Opposed Czech-US DCA and US bases and demanded government resignation (S004).

state_response.summary: Police separated opponents and supporters; article says no fines/detentions (S004).

notes: Protested the Czech-US DCA, demanded government resignation, opposed US bases. Article says police separated opponents/supporters and no fines/detentions occurred; no other response inferred. Footer credits ČTK.
open_questions: Count approximate; no bounds or complete state-response record.
